preconditions.description: The grid size n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.description: Bob chooses a color b that is different from Alice's chosen color a, and b is between 1 and 3 inclusive.
Bob places the token in a cell (i, j) where both i and j are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(grid[x][y] == 0 for x in range(n) for y in range(n) if (x, y) != (i-1, j-1))
postconditions.description: The chosen cell (i, j) is empty before Bob places the token.
